lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters arranged in quasi-vertical columns of 4-5 units, positioned posterior to the gills and pectoral fin attachment.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to form a regular grid pattern on the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three horizontal ridges visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient from high luminance (dorsal) to low luminance (ventral).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Horizontal linear white marks (scars) on the posterior flank below the first dorsal fin, and irregular white marks at the trailing edge of the dorsal fin base.
other_distinctive_markers: High-density concentration of small, circular high-luminance spots on the dorsal surface of the visible pectoral fin.
